rules_ds:
from math import floor

schema P scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    n: Int mutable

schema Q scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    d: Int mutable
    f: Float mutable

rule ratio:
    P p
    Q q where (p.n // q.d) > floor(q.f)
->
    log info "ratio"
